projects.name: Dattayog Farmers PVT. LTD. Website
projects.tagline: Marketing site for an agricultural and dairy products company.
projects.description: Built a marketing website for Dattayog Farmers Pvt. Ltd., a company in the agricultural and dairy products space. The site showcases their product catalogue and company story, and acts as the primary contact point for prospective customers.
features: Responsive layout across mobile and desktop
challenges: First project shipping React Router for client-side navigation — had to handle deep-linking and scroll restoration
Coordinating with a non-technical stakeholder for copy and imagery
results: Site is live at dattayog.com and has been the company's primary web presence since launch

projects.name: Portfolio Website for AnuDeep Industries
projects.tagline: Service-portfolio site for an agriculture services firm.
projects.description: Built a portfolio website for AnuDeep Industries, an Ichalkaranji-based company specializing in agriculture services. The site serves as a platform to showcase their extensive range of services.
challenges: First deployment of a Node app to a PaaS — had to debug build vs runtime environment differences
results: Replaced the company's previous static brochure site

projects.name: Opinions - Thoughts Sharing Platform
projects.tagline: Full-stack MERN blogging platform with auth and CRUD.
projects.description: A full-stack blogging platform where users can create, edit, and delete blogs. Built with the MERN stack.
features: Create, edit, and delete blog posts
challenges: Designing the MongoDB schema for nested comments and likes
Implementing JWT-based auth and route protection
results: Working full-stack reference app used to teach myself the MERN stack end to end

projects.name: remotelab
projects.description: A mobile-first control surface for VS Code — manage terminals, tasks, git, diagnostics, and Copilot CLI sessions from a phone.
challenges: Mapping VS Code's desktop UX to a phone screen without losing capability
Maintaining a stable extension host connection from mobile
results: Active development — used as a daily driver for code review on the go

projects.name: Project Athena
projects.tagline: AI assistant with tool-calling and document intelligence.
projects.description: An AI assistant with tool-calling and document intelligence. Locally hosted LLM (Qwen2.5-1.5B via Ollama) for conversational Q&A over a document corpus.
features: Document upload and ingestion (PDF, DOCX, CSV)
challenges: Keeping prompt context short for a 1.5B-param model
Implementing a tool registry that doesn't hardcode the LLM provider
results: End-to-end MVP runs locally; full SRS in /docs
